_about: Staged transcription of one reference channel. Text is copied verbatim from the cited files under docs/m2-handoff/ (only the bullet marker is removed). Card values were read from the card images. Nothing here is interpreted: identities are resolved in identity-map.json and numbers are parsed by the loader. The Spanish text of entries 1 to 16 comes from the supplementary recovery package (M2_Supplementary_Text_Recovery_58_Assaulters_16_Supporters).
